measures.label: nDCG@10
measures.line: Are the best answers near the top of the first 10? The usual choice.

measures.label: Precision@10
measures.line: How many of the first 10 results are good answers.

measures.label: Recall@50
measures.line: How many of the good answers show up in the first 50.

measures.label: MRR
measures.line: How high the first good answer sits.

measures.label: Searches with no results
measures.line: How often a question returns nothing at all.

measures.label: nDCG@10, traffic-weighted
measures.line: nDCG@10 where a question counts as often as it was searched.

measures.label: Click-through rate
measures.line: How often a simulated shopper clicks a result.

measures.label: Conversion
measures.line: How often a simulated shopper buys.

measures.label: Revenue per visit
measures.line: What a simulated shopper spends per visit.

slices.label: By group
slices.line: One result per group of questions (the group column of your questions).

slices.label: By traffic
slices.line: Head, torso and tail questions, by how often each was searched.
slices.needs: a weight on each question (logged searches have one)

limits.label: Smallest gain worth acting on
limits.line: In the deciding measure. A smaller difference reads as no clear difference.

limits.label: Simulated shoppers
limits.line: How many shoppers replay the logged searches on each model.

depths.label: nDCG looks this many results deep
Precision looks this many results deep
Recall looks this many results deep
MRR looks this many results deep
